settings.title: Additional local Beads project paths
settings.description: One absolute directory per line. Orca workspaces are included automatically. Remote hosts use an explicitly configured SSH destination.

settings.title: Remote Beads SSH connections
settings.description: JSON mapping Orca host IDs to {destination, configFile?, name?}. destination is a system SSH alias; configFile is an optional absolute SSH config path; name is a portable display label for shared filters. Never store credentials here.

settings.title: Remote PATH for bd and python3
settings.description: Colon-separated directories searched on the Linux host before the SSH default PATH. Tilde is expanded. Leave empty for ~/.local/bin, ~/bin, and /usr/local/bin. Commands run in bash --noprofile --norc, not the login shell.

settings.title: Board refresh interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often a visible panel reloads. Leave empty for 15 seconds on local projects and 60 seconds when any remote host is configured. Allowed range is 5 to 300.

settings.title: bd and SSH command timeout (seconds)
settings.description: Budget for one Beads request, including every SSH call it makes. Leave empty for 30 seconds locally and 60 seconds over SSH. Allowed range is 5 to 110.
